focus: D2 Security — fail-open dead hook and compact topic residue

findingDetails.title: Fail-open dead spawn masks incomplete hook removal
findingDetails.evidence: runChild swallows spawn errors (returns null). Combined with a deleted freshness script, Write events silently skip a formerly security-adjacent freshness/scan path without operator signal.
findingDetails.recommendation: Remove the dead call entirely; if a replacement freshness check is needed, emit an explicit observability event when the target is missing rather than silent null.
findingDetails.scopeProof: post-tool-use.mjs runChild catch returns null; CODE_GRAPH_FRESHNESS path absent on disk

findingDetails.title: compact-inject still tokenizes code_graph_* as attention topics
findingDetails.evidence: extractTopics regex still matches code_graph_\w+ from transcripts, keeping retired tool names in compact recovery context.
findingDetails.recommendation: Drop code_graph_\w+ from the topic regex; retain memory_/task_ patterns.
